name: lars-desktop
description: LARS Code Agent Desktop Control Center

scripts.build:desktop:all: npm run build && tauri build --target all
scripts.build:desktop:windows: npm run build && tauri build --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
scripts.build:desktop:macos: npm run build && tauri build --target universal-apple-darwin
scripts.build:desktop:linux: npm run build && tauri build --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
